profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer/Tech Lead
profile.summary:
+7 years of experience building/maintaining solutions for big companies in LATAM, and the USA.
+2 Years of experience as a Technical Lead.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineering
positions.description:
- Designing/Building node.js backend solution (proposal for our innovation initiative as a company).
- Enhancement for the weather backend application for the Alberta government with RoR.
- Design and implement an API Gateway to “wrap” the API communications for multiple US states, and simplify the client integration by exposing a unified interface.

positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.description:
- Designing/Building microservices with the Spring’s ecosystem.
- Design/Build ETLs to migrate more than 500k records using Spring Batch.
- Chatbot to automate PaaS using microservices and Microsoft cognitive services (Proposal solution).
- Designing/Building Serverless & RT (WebSockets protocol) backend applications.
- Serverless application to dispatch SMS messages using AWS (SES, Lambdas, API Gateway).
- PoC of authentication and authorization patterns using Cognito (User Pool) and the AWS Lambda+API GW.
- Support on the project setup using Docker+AWS+Spring ecosystem.
- Contribute as technical lead & mentor for a team of 6 members (4 Backend & 2 Frontend software engineers)

positions.title: Application Developer - Cognitive.Automation
positions.description:
- Building chatbots and POCs for Banking clients using Watson APIs.
- Development and maintenance of Backend applications using Spring stack.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Building bots to automate processes like bank website scraping to get confidential data to execute internal processes.
- Development, and maintenance of e-commerce plugins. 
- Building shell scripts to automate product deployments (CI/CD pipeline).
- Build POCs to explore solutions like multi processes vs threading (Python, GIL issue) to embrace the power of cloud-native applications.

positions.title: Software Engineer/Team leader
positions.description:
- Team leadership, being responsible for 7/10 software engineers and accomplishing administrative and technical tasks.
- POCs: exploring solutions for real-time communications protocol, and dashboard platform. 
- Implementation of the HA pattern in AWS.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Build/Maintenance eCommerce solutions based on the Magento platform. 
- Support as an IT Manager (Web servers, RDBMS like Percona, deployments processes).
- Solutions integrator: payment, and logistic methods.
- Technical lead: Being responsible for in-house solutions (innovation projects), and support in the coordination between remote and local teams.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Development, and maintenance of Billing platform (features, and fixes).
- Technical lead for in-house projects: being responsible for the LATAM device platform. 
- Services integrator (Telcel).

positions.title: Senior IT Consultant
positions.description: - Build a WAP solution over TELECOM infrastructure and Bank communication through APIs.

positions.title: Entrepreneur/Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Building the XMASS platform to give the ability to students to co-design their learning plans.
- Collaborate as software engineer mentors for design external solutions.

company.name: CTIN Centro de Tecnología e Innovación
